  6:section ‹Trace type›

  8:(* a terminated lazy list with divergence
  9:
  10:  observable behavior
  11:  - infinite activity
  12:  - termination
  13:  - divergence
  14:*)
  15:codatatype ('e, 's) ctrace =
  16:  is_TCons : TCons 'e "('e, 's) ctrace" |
  17:  is_Term : Term 's |
  18:  is_Div : Div
  19:
  20:lemma is_TConsE [elim]:
  21:  "⟦ is_TCons tr; ⋀ e tr'. tr = TCons e tr' ⟹ Q⟧ ⟹ Q"
  22:  by (metis is_TCons_def)
  23:
  24:lemma is_TermE [elim]:
  25:  "⟦ is_Term tr; ⋀ x. tr = Term x ⟹ Q⟧ ⟹ Q"
  26:  by (metis is_Term_def)

  28:coinductive ctrace_of :: "('e, 's, 'b) ctree ⇒ ('e, 's) ctrace ⇒ bool"
  29:  where
  30:trace_of_RetI [intro]: "ctrace_of (Ret x) (Term x)" |
  31:― ‹implies that the equation P = τ P will give use ‹Div›? Yes because we are doing a gfp construction.›
  32:trace_of_SilI [intro]: "ctrace_of P t ⟹ ctrace_of (τ P) t" | 
  33:― ‹This allows for nondeterministic choice which makes it a relation.›
  34:trace_of_VisI [intro]: "⟦ ∃ P ∈⇩b (K e). ctrace_of P t ⟧⟹ ctrace_of (Vis K) (TCons e t)"
  35:monos bBex_mono
  36:
  37:lemma ctrace_of_coind [elim, consumes 1, case_names Ret Sil Vis, induct pred: "ctrace_of"]:
  38:  assumes major: "φ P tr"
  39:      and minor_Ret: "⋀ x tr. φ (Ret x) tr ⟹ tr = Term x"
  40:      and minor_Sil: "⋀ P tr. φ (τ P) tr ⟹ φ P tr ∨ ctrace_of P tr"
  41:      and minor_Vis: "⋀ K tr. φ (Vis K) tr ⟹ ∃ e tr'. tr = (TCons e tr') ∧ (∃ P ∈⇩b (K e) . φ P tr' ∨ ctrace_of P tr')"
  42:    shows "ctrace_of P tr"
  43:  using major
  44:  apply (coinduct rule: ctrace_of.coinduct)
  45:  subgoal for P tr
  46:    apply (cases P)
  47:    subgoal
  48:      apply (rule disjI1)
  49:      using minor_Ret by auto
  50:    subgoal for P'
  51:      apply (rule disjI2)
  52:      apply (rule disjI1)
  53:      using minor_Sil by auto
  54:    subgoal for K
  55:      apply (rule disjI2)
  56:      apply (rule disjI2)
  57:      using minor_Vis by auto
  58:    done
  59:  done

  61:lemma ctrace_Ret [iff]:
  62:  "ctrace_of (Ret x) t ⟷ t = Term x"
  63:  apply auto
  64:  using ctrace_of.cases by fastforce
  65:
  66:lemma ctrace_of_Sil [iff]:
  67:  "ctrace_of (τ P) t ⟷ ctrace_of P t" 
  68:  apply auto
  69:  apply coinduction
  70:  apply auto
  71:  by (smt (verit, best) bballE bbexE ctree.distinct(1,5) ctree.inject(2) ctrace_of.cases)
  72:
  73:lemma ctrace_of_Sils [simp]:
  74:  "ctrace_of (Sils n P) t ⟷ ctrace_of P t"
  75:  by (induction n; auto)

  77:subsection ‹Visible steps and traces›
  78:
  79:text ‹
  80:  Visible steps are also nondeterministic so the characterization is a bit more convoluted.
  81:  There are two possible outcomes for ‹ctrace_of (Vis K) tr›:
  82:
  83:  1. ‹K› is empty, no successor
  84:  2. ‹K› is not empty
  85:
  86:  For 1 ‹Vis K› has no transitions so there are no traces.
  87:›
  88:
  89:lemma ctrace_of_Vis [iff]:
  90:  "ctrace_of (Vis K) tr ⟷ (∃ e tr'. tr = TCons e tr' ∧ (∃ P ∈⇩b (K e). ctrace_of P tr'))"
  91:  using ctrace_of.simps[of "Vis K" tr] by auto
  92:
  93:lemma ctrace_of_Vis_simps [simp]:
  94:  "ctrace_of (Vis K) (Term x) ⟷ False"
  95:  "ctrace_of (Vis K) Div ⟷ False"
  96:  by auto
  97:
  98:lemma ctrace_of_Vis_TCons [iff]:
  99:  "ctrace_of (Vis K) (TCons e tr) ⟷ (∃ P ∈⇩b (K e). ctrace_of P tr)"
  100:  by (auto elim: ctrace_of.cases)
  101:
  102:lemma ctrace_of_VisE [elim]:
  103:  assumes "ctrace_of (Vis K) tr"
  104:    and "⋀ e tr' P. ⟦ tr = TCons e tr'; P ∈⇩b (K e); ctrace_of P tr'⟧ ⟹ R"
  105:  shows R
  106:  using assms by auto
  107:
  108:text ‹
  109:  And we can have case distinction on not being a trace of a ‹Vis K› node.
  110:›
  111:
  112:lemma not_ctrace_of_Vis_cases:
  113:  "¬ ctrace_of (Vis K) tr ⟷ ¬ is_TCons tr ∨ (∃ e tr'. tr = TCons e tr' ∧ (∀ P ∈⇩b (K e). ¬ ctrace_of P tr'))"
  114:  by (cases tr; auto)

  247:section ‹Terminating and reactive traces›
  248:
  249:text ‹
  250:  The @{type ctrace} codatatype describes either terminating observations
  251:  or nonterminating observations.
  252:›
  253:
  254:subsection ‹Terminating trace›
  255:
  256:abbreviation non_terminating_trace :: "('e, 'r) ctrace ⇒ bool" where
  257:"non_terminating_trace tr ≡ is_TCons tr"
  258:
  259:abbreviation terminating_trace :: "('e, 'r) ctrace ⇒ bool" where
  260:"terminating_trace tr ≡ ¬ non_terminating_trace tr"
  261:
  262:translations "CONST terminating_trace tr" <= "¬ CONST non_terminating_trace tr"
  263:
  264:
  265:lemma terminating_Term [intro]: "terminating_trace (Term x)"
  266:  by auto
  267:
  268:lemma terminating_Div [intro]: "terminating_trace Div"
  269:  by auto
  270:
  271:lemma terminating_traceE:
  272:  assumes "terminating_trace tr" "is_Term tr ⟹ Q" "is_Div tr ⟹ Q"
  273:  shows Q
  274:  by (meson assms(1,2,3) ctrace.exhaust_disc)
  275:
  276:(* the counterpart to Sils for traces is a finite prefix of events *)
  277:
  278:fun Evs :: "'e list ⇒ ('e, 'r) ctrace ⇒ ('e, 'r) ctrace"
  279:  where
  280:"Evs [] tr = tr" |
  281:"Evs (e # es) tr = TCons e (Evs es tr)"
  282:
  283:lemma is_TCons_Evs [simp]: "is_TCons (Evs es tr) ⟷ (es ≠ [] ∨ is_TCons tr)"
  284:by (induction es; auto)
  285:
  286:lemma is_Term_Evs [simp]: "is_Term (Evs es tr) ⟷ es = [] ∧ is_Term tr"
  287:by (induction es; auto)
  288:
  289:lemma is_Div_Evs [simp]: "is_Div (Evs es tr) ⟷ es = [] ∧ is_Div tr"
  290:by (induction es; auto)
  291:
  292:lemma Evs_append [simp]: "Evs es (Evs es' tr) = Evs (es @ es') tr"
  293:by (induction es arbitrary: es'; auto)
  294:
  295:lemma Evs_Term [iff]:
  296:  "Term y = Evs es tr ⟷ es = [] ∧ tr = Term y"
  297:  by (cases es; auto)
  298:
  299:lemma Evs_Div [iff]:
  300:  "Div = Evs es tr ⟷ es = [] ∧ tr = Div"
  301:  by (cases es; auto)
  302:
  303:lemma ctrace_of_prefix_Div:
  304:  shows "ctrace_of P (Evs es Div) ⟷ (∀ tr. ctrace_of P (Evs es tr))"
  305:  apply (induction es arbitrary: P)
  306:  subgoal
  307:    apply (simp add: ctrace_of_all_diverge)
  308:    done
  309:  subgoal for e es P
  310:    apply (simp only: Evs.simps)
  311:    by (metis ctrace_of_TCons_simps)
  312:  done
  313:
  314:definition "terminates tr ≡ (∃ es tr'. tr = Evs es tr' ∧ terminating_trace tr')"
  315:
  316:lemma terminates_Term [simp]: "terminates (Term x)"
  317:unfolding terminates_def
  318:by (metis Evs.simps(1) ctrace.disc(2))
  319:
  320:lemma terminates_Div [simp]: "terminates Div"
  321:unfolding terminates_def
  322:by (metis Evs.simps(1) ctrace.disc(3))
  323:
  324:lemma terminates_TCons [simp]: "terminates (TCons e tr) ⟷ terminates tr"
  325:  unfolding terminates_def
  326:  apply rule
  327:  subgoal
  328:    by (metis Evs.elims ctrace.discI(1) ctrace.inject(1))
  329:  subgoal
  330:    by (metis Evs.simps(2))
  331:  done
  332:
  333:lemma terminates_Evs [simp]: "terminates (Evs es tr) ⟷ terminates tr"
  334:  by (induction es; auto)
  335:
  336:lemma terminates_cases [elim]:
  337:  assumes "terminates tr"
  338:  obtains (Term) es x where "tr = Evs es (Term x)" | (Div) es where "tr = Evs es Div"
  339:  using assms
  340:  unfolding terminates_def
  341:  apply auto
  342:  subgoal for es tr'
  343:    apply (induction es arbitrary: tr)
  344:    subgoal
  345:      apply (cases tr'; auto)
  346:      done
  347:    subgoal for e es tr
  348:      apply (cases tr'; auto)
  349:      subgoal for x
  350:        by (metis Evs.simps(2))
  351:      subgoal
  352:        by (metis Evs.simps(2))
  353:      done
  354:    done
  355:  done
  356:
  357:lemma terminates_induct [consumes 1, case_names Term TCons Div]:
  358:  assumes major: "terminates tr"
  359:      and minor_Term: "⋀ x. P (Term x)"
  360:      and minor_TCons: "⋀ e tr. terminates tr ⟹ P tr ⟹ P (TCons e tr)"
  361:      and minor_Div: "P Div"
  362:    shows "P tr"
  363:  using assms
  364:  proof(cases rule: terminates_cases)
  365:    case (Term es x)
  366:    then show ?thesis
  367:    by (induction es arbitrary: tr; auto simp add: minor_Term minor_TCons)
  368:  next
  369:    case (Div es)
  370:    then show ?thesis
  371:    by(induction es arbitrary: tr; auto simp add: minor_Div minor_TCons)
  372:  qed
  373:
  374:lemma ctrace_of_prefix_closed:
  375:  ― ‹the trace set of any ctree is prefix-closed: a terminating trace with events ‹es1 @ es2›
  376:     witnesses that events ‹es1› are reachable›
  377:  "ctrace_of P (Evs (es1 @ es2) (Term x)) ⟹ ∃ tr'. ctrace_of P (Evs es1 tr')"
  378:  by (metis Evs_append)
  379:
  380:
  381:subsection ‹Reactive trace›
  382:
  383:coinductive reactive
  384:  where
  385:"reactive tr ⟹ reactive (TCons e tr)"
  386:
  387:lemma reactive_Div [simp]:
  388:   "¬ reactive Div"
  389:  by (meson ctrace.simps(6) reactive.cases)
  390:
  391:lemma reactive_Term [simp]:
  392:   "¬ reactive (Term x)"
  393:  by (meson ctrace.simps(4) reactive.cases)
  394:
  395:lemma reactive_TCons [iff]:
  396:  "reactive (TCons e tr) ⟷ reactive tr"
  397:  apply rule
  398:  subgoal
  399:    apply (auto elim: reactive.cases)
  400:    done
  401:  subgoal
  402:    apply (auto intro: reactive.intros)
  403:    done
  404:  done
  405:
  406:lemma reactive_Evs [simp]:
  407:  "reactive (Evs es tr) ⟷ reactive tr"
  408:  apply (induction es)
  409:  apply auto
  410:  done
  411:
  412:lemma reactive_iff:
  413:  "reactive tr ⟷ (∃ e tr'. tr = TCons e tr' ∧ reactive tr')"
  414:  by (auto elim: reactive.cases)
  415:
  416:subsection ‹Terminating or reactive›
  417:
  418:lemma reactive_does_not_terminate:
  419:  "¬ terminates tr ⟷ reactive tr"
  420:  apply rule
  421:  subgoal
  422:    apply (coinduction arbitrary: tr)
  423:    apply (unfold terminates_def)
  424:    by (metis Evs.simps(1,2) ctrace.collapse(1))
  425:  subgoal
  426:    apply (unfold terminates_def)
  427:    apply (drule reactive_iff[THEN iffD1])
  428:    apply (erule exE)
  429:    apply (erule exE)
  430:    apply rule
  431:    apply (erule exE)
  432:    apply (erule exE)
  433:    apply (erule conjE)
  434:    apply (erule conjE)
  435:    subgoal for e tr' es str
  436:      apply (induction es arbitrary: e tr tr')
  437:      subgoal for e tr
  438:        by (metis Evs.simps(1) ctrace.disc(1))
  439:      subgoal for e e' es' itr itr'
  440:        apply (simp only: Evs.simps ctrace.inject)
  441:        apply (erule conjE)
  442:        by (meson reactive_iff)
  443:      done
  444:   done
  445: done
  446:
  447:lemma terminate_then_not_reactive:
  448:  "terminates tr ⟷ ¬ reactive tr"
  449:  using reactive_does_not_terminate by auto
  450:
  451:lemma ctrace_behavior_cases [elim, consumes 0, case_names Terminates Reactive]:
  452:  fixes tr :: "('e, 'r) ctrace"
  453:  assumes "⟦ terminates tr ⟧ ⟹ P"
  454:      and "⟦ reactive tr ⟧ ⟹ P"
  455:    shows P
  456:  using assms terminate_then_not_reactive
  457:  apply (cases "terminates tr")
  458:  apply auto
  459:  done

  461:subsection ‹Terminating, reactive traces and sequential composition›
  462:
  463:text ‹
  464:  Sequential composition @{term bind_ctree} is supposed to sequentially compose traces.
  465:  These lemmas try to characterise the behavior of sequential composition on terminating
  466:  and nonterminating traces.
  467:›
  468:
  469:lemma reactive_trace_bind:
  470:  "reactive tr ⟹ ctrace_of P tr ⟹ ctrace_of (P ⤜ Q) tr"
  471:  apply (coinduction arbitrary: P tr rule: ctrace_of_coind)
  472:  subgoal for x P' tr
  473:    apply auto
  474:    done
  475:  subgoal for P' P tr
  476:    apply auto
  477:    done
  478:  subgoal for K P' tr
  479:    apply auto
  480:    apply (drule reactive_iff[THEN iffD1])
  481:    apply auto
  482:    by (metis (mono_tags, lifting) Vis_Sils bbexI bimageI comp_apply)
  483:  done
  484:
  485:lemma ctrace_of_bind_split:
  486:  "ctrace_of P (Evs es (Term x)) ⟹ ctrace_of (Q x) tr' ⟹ ctrace_of (P ⤜ Q) (Evs es tr')"
  487:  apply (induction es arbitrary: P)
  488:  subgoal
  489:    apply auto
  490:    done
  491:  subgoal for e es P
  492:    apply auto
  493:    by blast
  494:  done
  495:
  496:lemma ctrace_of_bind_subdiv:
  497:  "ctrace_of P (Evs es Div) ⟹ ctrace_of (P ⤜ Q) (Evs es tr')" 
  498:  apply (induction es arbitrary: P)
  499:  subgoal
  500:    apply auto
  501:    done
  502:  subgoal for e es P
  503:    apply auto
  504:    by blast
  505:  done

  507:lemma bind_Sils_Vis_dest:
  508:  fixes P :: "('e, 'r) ctree['b]" and Q :: "'r  ⇒ ('e, 's) ctree['b]"
  509:  assumes eq: "P ⤜ Q = Sils n (Vis K)"
  510:      and nd: "P ≠ diverge"
  511:  obtains
  512:    (Ret) m y where "P = Sils m (Ret y)" and "Q y = Sils (n - m) (Vis K)"
  513:  | (Vis) F where "P = Sils n (Vis F)" and "K = map_bset (λr. r ⤜ Q) o F"
  514:proof -
  515:  have disj: "(∃ m y. P = Sils m (Ret y) ∧ Q y = Sils (n - m) (Vis K)) ∨
  516:              (∃ F. P = Sils n (Vis F) ∧ K = map_bset (λr. r ⤜ Q) o F)"
  517:    using assms
  518:  proof (induction n arbitrary: P)
  519:    case 0
  520:    then have eq0: "P ⤜ Q = Vis K" by simp
  521:    show ?case
  522:    by (metis Sils_0 bind_ctree_VisE' diff_0_eq_0 eq0)
  523:  next
  524:    case (Suc n)
  525:    then have eqS: "P ⤜ Q = Sil (Sils n (Vis K))" by simp
  526:    show ?case
  527:    by (smt (verit, ccfv_threshold) Sils.simps(2) Sils_0 Sils_Vis_not_Ret Suc.IH Suc.prems(1,2) bind_Sils bind_SilsE bind_ctree_VisE diff_self_eq_0 diverge.code)
  528:  qed
  529:  then show thesis
  530:  sledgehammer
  531:  using Ret Vis by blast
  532:qed

  534:lemma ctrace_of_terminates_bind:
  535:  assumes "terminates tr" and "P ≠ diverge" and "ctrace_of (P ⤜ Q) tr"
  536:  obtains
  537:    (Term) ― ‹the trace decomposes into two parts, one accepted by P and one accepted by Q›
  538:    tr⇩P tr⇩Q x where "ctrace_of P (Evs tr⇩P (Term x))"
  539:    and "ctrace_of (Q x) tr⇩Q"
  540:    and "tr = Evs tr⇩P tr⇩Q" ― ‹implicit that ‹tr⇩Q› terminates›
  541:  | (Div) ― ‹trace tr contains a prefix es such that ‹ctrace_of P (Evs es Div)››
  542:    prefix suffix where "ctrace_of P (Evs prefix Div)" and "tr = Evs prefix suffix"
  543:  using assms
  544:proof (induction arbitrary: P rule: terminates_induct)
  545:  case (Term x)
  546:  then show ?case
  547:    apply (simp only: ctrace_of_Term_simps)
  548:    apply (erule disjE)
  549:    apply (erule exE)
  550:    apply (drule bind_Sils_dest)
  551:    apply (erule disjE)
  552:    apply (auto elim!: bind_ctree_RetE')
  553:    done
  554:next
  555:  case Div
  556:  then show ?case by (auto elim!: bind_SilsE)
  557:next
  558:  case (TCons e tr')
  559:  thm TCons.IH TCons.prems(1)
  560:  note all_hyps = this
  561:  show ?case
  562:  proof -
  563:    note IH = all_hyps(2) and Term_elim = all_hyps(3) and Div_elim = all_hyps(4)
  564:    note pnd = all_hyps(5) and bind_tr = all_hyps(6)
  565:    consider
  566:      (ret) y where "ctrace_of P (Term y)" "ctrace_of (Q y) (TCons e tr')" |
  567:      (vis_f) n F where "P = Sils n (Vis F)" "∃ r ∈⇩b F e. ctrace_of (r ⤜ Q) tr'"
  568:    proof -
  569:      from bind_tr have
  570:        "(∃n K P'. P ⤜ Q = Sils n (Vis K) ∧ P' ∈⇩b K e ∧ ctrace_of P' tr') ∨ P ⤜ Q = diverge"
  571:        by simp
  572:      then show thesis
  573:      proof (elim disjE exE conjE)
  574:        fix n K P'
  575:        assume eq: "P ⤜ Q = Sils n (Vis K)"
  576:          and P'_mem: "P' ∈⇩b K e"
  577:          and P'_tr: "ctrace_of P' tr'"
  578:        from bind_Sils_Vis_dest[OF eq pnd] show thesis
  579:        proof cases
  580:          case (1 m y)
  581:          assume P_Ret: "P = Sils m (Ret y)" and Q_Vis: "Q y = Sils (n - m) (Vis K)"
  582:          have ctP: "ctrace_of P (Term y)" using P_Ret by auto
  583:          have ctQy: "ctrace_of (Q y) (TCons e tr')" using Q_Vis P'_mem P'_tr by (auto simp: ctrace_of_Sils)
  584:          show thesis by (rule ret[OF ctP ctQy])
  585:        next
  586:          case (2 F)
  587:          assume P_Vis: "P = Sils n (Vis F)" and K_eq: "K = map_bset (λ ck. ck ⤜ Q) o F"
  588:          have wit: "∃r ∈⇩b F e. ctrace_of (r ⤜ Q) tr'" using K_eq P'_mem P'_tr by (auto simp: bimage_iff)
  589:          show thesis by (rule vis_f[OF P_Vis wit])
  590:        qed
  591:      next
  592:        assume "P ⤜ Q = diverge"
  593:        then have "P = diverge ∨ (∃n x. P = Sils n (Ret x) ∧ Q x = diverge)" by auto
  594:        then show thesis
  595:        using pnd ret by force
  596:      qed
  597:    qed
  598:    then show thesis
  599:    proof cases
  600:      case ret
  601:      show thesis 
  602:        apply (rule Term_elim[of "[]" y "TCons e tr'"])
  603:        using ret by (auto simp: Evs.simps)
  604:    next
  605:      case vis_f
  606:      then obtain r where r_in_F: "r ∈⇩b F e" and r_bind: "ctrace_of (r ⤜ Q) tr'" by auto
  607:      show thesis
  608:      proof (cases "r = diverge")
  609:        case True
  610:        have Pctr: "ctrace_of P (Evs [e] Div)"
  611:          using vis_f(1) r_in_F True
  612:          by (auto simp: Evs.simps ctrace_of_TCons_simps)
  613:        show thesis using Div_elim[OF Pctr] by (auto simp: Evs.simps)
  614:      next
  615:        case False
  616:        show thesis
  617:          apply (rule IH[of r])
  618:          subgoal for trP x trQ
  619:            apply (rule Term_elim[of "e # trP" x trQ])
  620:            using vis_f(1) r_in_F apply (auto simp: Evs.simps ctrace_of_TCons_simps intro!: bexI)
  621:            done
  622:          subgoal for prefix suf
  623:            apply (rule Div_elim[of "e # prefix" suf])
  624:            using vis_f(1) r_in_F apply (auto simp: Evs.simps ctrace_of_TCons_simps intro!: bexI)
  625:            done
  626:          apply (rule False)
  627:          apply (rule r_bind)
  628:          done
  629:      qed
  630:    qed
  631:  qed
  632:qed

  634:lemma ctrace_of_reactive_bind:
  635:  assumes "reactive tr" and "P ≠ diverge" and "ctrace_of (P ⤜ Q) tr"
  636:  obtains ― ‹either it's a prefix or fully stays in P›
  637:    (Prefix) es tr⇩Q x where "ctrace_of P (Evs es (Term x))"
  638:    and "ctrace_of (Q x) tr⇩Q"
  639:    and "Evs es tr⇩Q = tr" ― ‹implicit that ‹tr⇩Q› is reactive›
  640:  | (Reactive) "ctrace_of P tr"
  641:proof -
  642:  show ?thesis
  643:  proof (cases "∃ tr⇩P x tr⇩Q. ctrace_of P (Evs tr⇩P (Term x)) ∧ ctrace_of (Q x) tr⇩Q ∧ Evs tr⇩P tr⇩Q = tr")
  644:    case True
  645:    then obtain tr⇩P x tr⇩Q where
  646:      "ctrace_of P (Evs tr⇩P (Term x))" "ctrace_of (Q x) tr⇩Q" "Evs tr⇩P tr⇩Q = tr"
  647:      by auto
  648:    then show ?thesis by (rule Prefix)
  649:  next
  650:    case False
  651:    show ?thesis
  652:    proof (rule Reactive)
  653:      from assms and False show "ctrace_of P tr"
  654:      apply(coinduction arbitrary: P tr rule: ctrace_of_coind)
  655:      subgoal for x P
  656:        by (metis Evs.simps(1) bind_ctree_simps(1) trace_of_RetI)
  657:      subgoal for P' P tr
  658:        apply auto
  659:        done
  660:      subgoal for K P tr
  661:        apply auto
  662:        subgoal for e tr' P'
  663:          apply (rule bbexI[where ?x=P'])
  664:          apply auto
  665:          by (meson Evs.simps(2) bbexI)
  666:        done
  667:      done
  668:     qed
  669:  qed
  670:qed

  672:lemma ctrace_of_bind_cases [consumes 1, case_names Diverge ReactiveP Split SubDiverge]:
  673:  assumes major: "ctrace_of (P ⤜ Q) tr"
  674:  obtains
  675:      (Diverge)    "P = diverge" |
  676:      (ReactiveP)   "reactive tr" and "ctrace_of P tr" |
  677:      (Split)      es x tr' where "tr = Evs es tr'"
  678:                              and "ctrace_of P (Evs es (Term x))"
  679:                              and "ctrace_of (Q x) tr'" |
  680:      (SubDiverge) es tr' where "tr = Evs es tr'"
  681:                            and "ctrace_of P (Evs es Div)"
  682:proof(cases tr rule: ctrace_behavior_cases)
  683:  case Terminates
  684:  then show ?thesis
  685:  proof(cases "P = diverge")
  686:    case True
  687:    then show ?thesis using Diverge by auto
  688:  next
  689:    case False
  690:    show ?thesis
  691:      apply (rule ctrace_of_terminates_bind)
  692:      apply (rule Terminates)
  693:      apply (rule False)
  694:      apply (rule major)
  695:      subgoal for tr⇩P tr⇩Q x ― ‹Term case›
  696:        apply (rule Split; auto)
  697:        done
  698:      subgoal for prefix suffix ― ‹Div case›
  699:        apply (rule SubDiverge)
  700:        apply auto
  701:        done
  702:      done
  703:   qed
  704:next
  705:  case Reactive
  706:  then show ?thesis
  707:  proof(cases "P = diverge")
  708:    case True
  709:    then show ?thesis using Diverge by auto
  710:  next
  711:    case False
  712:    show ?thesis
  713:      apply (rule ctrace_of_reactive_bind)
  714:      apply (rule Reactive)
  715:      apply (rule False)
  716:      apply (rule major)
  717:      subgoal ― ‹Prefix›
  718:        apply (rule Split)
  719:        apply auto
  720:        done
  721:      subgoal ― ‹Reactive›
  722:        apply (rule ReactiveP)
  723:        apply (rule Reactive)
  724:        apply assumption
  725:        done
  726:      done
  727:  qed
  728:qed

  730:section ‹Trace coercion›
  731:
  732:(* NOTE the ctrace_of_terminates_bind and ctrace_of_reactive_bind lemmas
  733:   require casting traces.
  734:
  735:   E.g. reactive tr and ctrace_of P tr ⟹ ctrace_of (P ⤜ Q) tr
  736:
  737:   But the trace tr is typed, e.g. tr :: ('e, 'r) ctrace, and if Q accepts
  738:   only ('e, 's) ctrace when ('e, 'r) ctrace is accepted by P then things
  739:   are not good.
  740: *)
  741:
  742:primcorec cast_trace :: "('e, 'r) ctrace ⇒ ('e, 's) ctrace" where
  743:  "cast_trace tr = (case tr of
  744:      TCons e tr' ⇒ TCons e (cast_trace tr')
  745:    | _           ⇒ Div)"
  746:
  747:lemma cast_trace_TCons [simp]:
  748:  "cast_trace (TCons e tr) = TCons e (cast_trace tr)"
  749:  by (simp add: cast_trace.code)
  750:
  751:lemma cast_trace_Term [simp]:
  752:  "cast_trace (Term x) = Div"
  753:  by (simp add: cast_trace.code)
  754:
  755:lemma cast_trace_Div [simp]:
  756:  "cast_trace (Div :: ('e,'r) ctrace) = (Div :: ('e,'s) ctrace)"
  757:  by (simp add: cast_trace.code)
  758:
  759:lemma reactive_cast_trace [simp]:
  760:  "reactive tr ⟹ reactive (cast_trace tr)"
  761:  apply (coinduction arbitrary: tr rule: reactive.coinduct)
  762:  apply (drule reactive_iff[THEN iffD1], clarify)
  763:  apply (rule exI[where x = "cast_trace _"])
  764:  apply simp
  765:  apply blast
  766:  done
  767:
  768:lemma cast_trace_Evs [simp]:
  769:  "cast_trace (Evs es tr) = Evs es (cast_trace tr)"
  770:  by (induction es) auto
  771:
  772:text ‹
  773:  The next three lemmas are the key interface for the generalised ReactiveP case.
  774:  They are stated with @{command sorry} and will be proved once the cast
  775:  machinery matures.
  776:
  777:  @{text ctrace_of_cast_reactive}: a reactive trace @{term tr} of a tree P is
  778:  preserved under @{const cast_trace} (only the phantom return type changes).
  779:
  780:  @{text reactive_trace_bind_cast}: polymorphic version of @{thm reactive_trace_bind}.
  781:  If P has a reactive trace @{term "tr⇩P :: ('e,'r) ctrace"} then the bind
  782:  P ⤜ Q (with Q :: 'r ⇒ ('e,'s) ctree['b]) has the cast trace
  783:  @{term "cast_trace tr⇩P :: ('e,'s) ctrace"}.
  784:
  785:  @{text ctrace_of_bind_reactive_inv}: if @{term "bind_ctree P Q"} has a
  786:  reactive trace @{term tr} then P has a reactive trace of its own return type
  787:  that casts to @{term tr}.
  788:›
  789:
  790:lemma ctrace_of_cast_reactive:
  791:  assumes "reactive tr" "ctrace_of P tr"
  792:  shows "ctrace_of P (cast_trace tr)"
  793:  using assms
  794:  apply (coinduction arbitrary: P tr rule: ctrace_of_coind)
  795:  apply auto
  796:  by blast

  798:lemma ctrace_of_reactive_bind':
  799:  fixes P :: "('e, 'r) ctree['b]" and Q :: "'r ⇒ ('e, 's) ctree['b]"
  800:  assumes "reactive tr" and "P ≠ diverge" and "ctrace_of (P ⤜ Q) tr"
  801:  obtains ― ‹either it's a prefix or fully stays in P›
  802:    (Prefix) es tr⇩Q x where "ctrace_of P (Evs es (Term x))"
  803:    and "ctrace_of (Q x) tr⇩Q"
  804:    and "Evs es tr⇩Q = tr" ― ‹implicit that ‹tr⇩Q› is reactive›
  805:  | (Reactive) "ctrace_of P (cast_trace tr)" ― ‹type-coercion›
  806:proof -
  807:  show ?thesis
  808:  proof (cases "∃ tr⇩P x tr⇩Q. ctrace_of P (Evs tr⇩P (Term x)) ∧ ctrace_of (Q x) tr⇩Q ∧ Evs tr⇩P tr⇩Q = tr")
  809:    case True
  810:    then obtain tr⇩P x tr⇩Q where
  811:      "ctrace_of P (Evs tr⇩P (Term x))" "ctrace_of (Q x) tr⇩Q" "Evs tr⇩P tr⇩Q = tr"
  812:      by auto
  813:    then show ?thesis by (rule Prefix)
  814:  next
  815:    case False
  816:    show ?thesis
  817:    proof (rule Reactive)
  818:      from assms and False
  819:      show "ctrace_of P (cast_trace tr)"
  820:      apply(coinduction arbitrary: P tr rule: ctrace_of_coind)
  821:      subgoal for x P
  822:        by (metis Evs.simps(1) bind_ctree_simps(1) trace_of_RetI)
  823:      subgoal for P' P tr
  824:        apply auto+
  825:        done
  826:      subgoal for K P tr
  827:        apply auto
  828:        subgoal for e tr' P'
  829:          apply (rule bbexI[where ?x=P'])
  830:          apply auto
  831:          apply (rule exI[where ?x=tr'])
  832:          apply auto
  833:          by (meson Evs.simps(2) bbexI)
  834:        done
  835:      done
  836:     qed
  837:  qed
  838:qed

  899:lemma reactive_trace_bind':
  900:  "reactive tr ⟹ ctrace_of P (cast_trace tr) ⟹ ctrace_of (P ⤜ Q) tr"
  901:  apply (coinduction arbitrary: P tr rule: ctrace_of_coind)
  902:  subgoal for x P' tr
  903:    by (metis bind_ctree_RetE' ctrace_Ret reactive_Term reactive_cast_trace)
  904:  subgoal for P' P tr
  905:    apply auto
  906:    by (metis bind_ctree_Sil_dest ctrace_Ret ctrace_of_Sil reactive_Term reactive_cast_trace)
  907:  subgoal for K P' tr
  908:    apply auto
  909:    apply (drule reactive_iff[THEN iffD1])
  910:    apply auto
  911:    apply (metis (mono_tags, lifting) Vis_Sils bbexCI bimageI comp_apply)
  912:    by fastforce
  913:  done

  915:lemma ctrace_of_bind_reactive_inv:
  916:  fixes P :: "('e, 'r, 'b) ctree" and Q :: "'r ⇒ ('e, 's, 'b) ctree"
  917:    and tr :: "('e, 's) ctrace"
  918:  assumes "reactive tr" and "P ≠ diverge" and "ctrace_of (P ⤜ Q) tr"
  919:  obtains
  920:    (Prefix) es x tr⇩Q
  921:    where "reactive tr⇩Q" and "ctrace_of P (Evs es (Term x))" and "ctrace_of (Q x) tr⇩Q" |
  922:    (ReactiveP) tr⇩P :: "('e, 'r) ctrace"
  923:    where "reactive tr⇩P" and "ctrace_of P tr⇩P" and "cast_trace tr⇩P = tr"
  924:  sorry
